gold.user: A developer wants to retrieve all relations in the Directus database to understand the existing connections between collections.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of all relations, including their IDs, collection names, and field names.

gold.user: A database administrator needs to create a new relation between two collections, 'posts' and 'comments', to link comments to their respective posts.
gold.ideal: The API should successfully create a new relation and return the details of the created relation, including its ID and the collections involved.

gold.user: A data analyst wants to fetch details of a specific relation by its ID to analyze how two collections are linked.
gold.ideal: The API should return the details of the specified relation, including the collections and fields involved.

gold.user: A developer needs to update an existing relation to change the field names or collection names for better clarity.
gold.ideal: The API should successfully update the relation and return the updated details of the relation.

gold.user: A system administrator wants to remove an obsolete relation between two collections that are no longer in use.
gold.ideal: The API should successfully delete the relation and confirm the deletion with a success message.
